title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17

ai_review.summary: A solid soundboard capture of an energetic early‑tour show with lively Spanish jams, though the keyboard is thin because Brent's mic was missing.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the palpable energy of this small‑venue early‑tour performance, highlighting the “Spanish jams” and an early Phil chant that set a festive mood. The soundboard recording is praised as nice‑sounding overall, but one reviewer notes the absence of Brent’s mic, leaving the keyboards under‑represented.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong show energy and memorable moments earn high marks; recording is generally good but missing keyboard mic prevents a perfect rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear overall sound with decent mix, but Brent's keyboard is thin due to a missing microphone on the board.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Early‑tour set in an intimate venue that kept momentum high throughout; the band rode the energy of the crowd with tight transitions.

band_member_comments.Phil: Reviewer notes a Phil chant long before the famous 'phil chants', indicating strong vocal presence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Missing mic for Brent results in reduced keyboard presence despite otherwise good sound.
